input.objective: Build the Marginalia site against the live launch #1283 contracts (hook 0xf0457dd0cf526686190e4f057ba19db14d34a0cc on Ethereum mainnet; router, judge, treasury via hook.router()/judge()/treasury(); MARG 0xfa0efea559bde229031c2b0a219472316647759c; IMD 0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7). A static site, wallet-connected, reading the chain directly: (1) FEED of notes and theses from NotePosted events with live status from noteOf (open / right / wrong / void / retracted / thesis open / closed), author, token, side, target, horizon, bond, text, outcome and settle price from Settled; filters by token and author; (2) AUTHOR page: the record (score, posted, right, wrong, retracted) from records(address) and the author's notes; (3) NOTE page: the observations (Observed events), horizon end, settlement window, the outcome, parent/child links; (4) POST flow: choose token X and venue (Uniswap v4 pool key, v3 pool or v2 pair), call router.checkpointVenue first and show the one-hour wait clearly, then router.note(params, v4Key, imdIn, minMargOut, deadline) with the bond chosen inside BOND_MIN..BOND_MAX, IMD approval, and the stamp + MARG_BUY explained; theses (targetBps 0) with long text; counters via parentId; (5) SEAL flow: compute sealHash(author, params) client-side, call hook.seal(x, venue, hash), show the 30 min to 6 h reveal window and reveal by posting the same params; (6) POOLS page: refundPool(today), thesisPool(week), sweep and judging state; claimDeposit / claimRefund buttons for the connected author. Plain language throughout: a bonded feed, not a perp DEX, not a prediction market; nothing pays for being right; informational, not advice. Mobile-first, no backend, no analytics, no external APIs except the chain RPC. VERIFIED SPECIFICS (from a working prototype against the live contracts; use them as given): hook.router() = 0xa3579D7c59A2C0c742fC4e5BB18AF93241D1d263 and hook.judge() = 0xa9e1891d76553195B4Cbcd0F8Db290C8C0FA28B9 (EIP-1167 clones; ABIs = MarginaliaRouter / MarginaliaJudge in this repository). Posting pulls IMD from the author by transferFrom, so the author approves the ROUTER for imdIn = STAMP 0.1 + MARG_BUY 0.25 + bond (bond in BOND_MIN 0.25 .. BOND_MAX 10 IMD). router.note(p, v4Key, imdIn, minMargOut, deadline) where minMargOut covers only the MARG_BUY leg (0.25 IMD worth of MARG at hook.margPriceInImd(), which returns IMD per MARG scaled 1e18; allow ~10% slippage). NoteParams.venue for the launch pool: kind 1 (UniV4), ref = keccak256(abi.encode(currency0 IMD 0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7, currency1 MARG, fee 12500, tickSpacing 60, hooks = the hook)), quote and xIsToken0 are derived by the router (pass IMD / false); pass the full PoolKey as v4Key. For a v3 pool: kind 2, ref = the pool address left-padded to bytes32; v2 pair: kind 3; v4Key then ignored. The venue must be quoted in IMD, WETH or native, and X must be a token of the pool. class = 1 (the router sets Traded/Agent itself). targetBps = 10000 + pct*100 for BUY, 10000 - pct*100 for SELL, min 10% away; a thesis is targetBps 0 and horizonDays 0 with text up to THESIS_TEXT_MAX 8192 bytes; call text up to TEXT_MAX 280 bytes. Checkpoint state: router.validateVenue(p, key) returns the derived Venue; router.priceWindows(keccak256(abi.encode(venue))) .startedAt is the window start; a post needs it 1 h to 6 h old; show a countdown. records(address) returns (int256 score scaled 1e4, uint32 posted, right, wrong, broken, retracted, judgedWins). noteOf(id) returns (author, x, side, targetBps, horizonDays, class, status, postPrice, postBalance, deposit, parentId, children); status enum Open, Right, Wrong, VoidSold, VoidNoData, Retracted, ThesisOpen, ThesisClosed. The venue is not in NotePosted nor noteOf: keep it client-side when posting. Public read RPC: any mainnet RPC; note that free-tier Alchemy limits eth_getLogs to 10 blocks per call, so read logs from a node that serves wide ranges (e.g. ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com) in ≤2000-block chunks from deploy block 26169583. Observations: hook.observe(id) is permissionless inside the 6 h window after horizonEnd(id); settle(id) after it; a keeper runs these, the site only shows them. ALSO: (7) VENUE FINDER: given a token address, resolve its canonical venues for the user instead of asking for a pool address: Uniswap v3 factory 0x1F98431c8aD98523631AE4a59f267346ea31F984 getPool(token, WETH 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 or IMD, fee in {100, 500, 3000, 10000}) and Uniswap v2 factory 0x5C69bEe701ef814a2B6a3EDD4B1652CB9cc5aA6f getPair(token, WETH or IMD); list the ones that exist with their liquidity and let the user pick; the launch pool is the only v4 venue offered. (8) PERMISSIONLESS KEEPER BUTTONS on the note page: when a call is inside its 6 h settlement window show an 'Observe' button calling hook.observe(id), and after the window a 'Settle' button calling hook.settle(id) (10% of a forfeited bond goes to the settler); on a thesis past its 7-day grace with no child, 'Forfeit' calling settleThesis(id). Anyone may press them; explain why. (9) SEALED-NOTE TEXT: v1 keeps the sealed text with the author (the site shows the seal event, the hash, the window and the reveal); delivery to key holders arrives with the key market in a later iteration — say so on the seal page. (10) The site's canonical links: x.com/marginalia_md, the explorer launch page, and the hook/MARG addresses in full in the footer with the line 'Informational and research purposes only. Not financial advice. Bonds can be lost.' REVIEW BRIEF for the review steps (read-only, before hosting): verify every contract address against the live ones named above; verify that approvals target ONLY the router and only for the amount shown; verify that every transaction the page builds matches the router/hook ABIs in this repository; verify there are no external scripts, no third-party RPC beyond the user's wallet and the public read node, no analytics, no remote code loading, no obfuscated code; verify the venue finder uses the canonical Uniswap factory addresses named above; verify the copy never promises returns, never says 'buy', and shows the disclaimer. Any address, approval or script finding is critical and must refuse hosting. LOOK: a ledger, not a terminal. Paper and ink: light background #f6f1e7 with ink #1d1a16, rust accent #b9471f for links and the primary button, a hairline rule #d9cfbd between entries; dark mode inverts to #15130f / #ece5d6 with the same accent. Serif body type (Iowan Old Style / Palatino / Georgia fallback), monospace only for addresses and ids. The mark is the manicule ☞ (a pointing hand, the marginalia glyph) next to the word Marginalia in the header. Notes render as entries in a ledger: a status tag, the token and the claim on one line, the text beneath, the author and bond in small type. No gradients, no glassmorphism, no stock crypto imagery, no charts. Mobile first; one column; 17px base.
